text:
sam_marketing: Heads-up: our EU launch draft mentions "customer telemetry" examples in the blog and privacy team flagged it. They say we need opt-in proof before publishing. Need a comms workaround quick. @privacy_luca @legal_kate

privacy_luca: Correct. Any labeled customer data or identifiable config examples require documented consent under GDPR rules. The draft uses anonymized IDs but still references region-specific deployments which can be re-identifying.

sam_marketing: Ok. What's quickest: remove the examples, swap to synthetic examples, or add consent attestation?

legal_kate: Fastest is swap to synthetic examples and a methodology note that states: "examples are synthetic and not derived from customer data." If partner wants a quote, we need signed consent.

jonathan_pr: We also need to avoid implying processing of EU personal data without DPA controls. Can marketing wording be more generic: "customers have reported..." vs naming regions?

product_maya: For technical credibility we can show performance graphs but use synthetic traces. Alex from research can generate them with identical shape but no real identifiers.

press_ops: Timeline impact? We planned to publish Fri EOD. If we swap examples now can we still hit that?

privacy_luca: If research can produce synthetic graphs today and legal approves the wording, Fri EOD is doable. But any partner quote with EU customer name will push timeline by 72h for consent.

sam_marketing: Research contact assigned. @product_maya will coordinate synthetic graph. Also: change phrase "collected telemetry" to "controlled tests and synthetic traces".

legal_kate: I'll draft the updated boilerplate: "Data examples shown are synthetic or aggregated; any customer quotes are used with explicit consent." Will post in 30m.

sales_eu: If we remove EU customer name we should notify our EU pilot customers so they don't get surprised. I'll send a FYI note once final copy is ready.

jonathan_pr: Also prepare a holding statement in case an EU outlet asks if we used real customer logs. Something short and clear.

press_ops: I'll keep press outreach paused until legal clears the new copy. Once green, we schedule the embargo and hand off to PR lists.

product_maya: Synthetic graphs uploaded to internal drive: https://internal.redwood/marketing/synth-graphs (internal). They match the shapes, no identifiers.

legal_kate: Boilerplate posted and approved: "Examples are synthetic or aggregated; no customer-identifiable data was used." Legal signs off. :white_check_mark:

sam_marketing: Great. Final checklist: (1) swap examples to synthetic (done), (2) replace wording (done), (3) sales EU FYI (sales_eu), (4) PR hold until green (press_ops).

press_ops: Copy approved. Scheduling holds lifted. Target publish Fri 17:00 CET / 08:00 PT. I'll share embargo list once published time confirmed.

sales_eu: FYI note drafted and sent to pilot POCs. No objections so far.

jonathan_pr: All set. Quick win on privacy-safe launch. Thanks all. Closing thread.
